asks: Ground control: abort the coffee break.
Visitor: take me to your leader.
Ship computer: please open the snack bay doors.
Earthling: can you teleport me to work?

Galactic bank: your loan is due in three light-years.
Robot: upgrade to Human 2.0?
Spaceship: update available. Restart now?
Asteroid: mind if I park in your orbit?
Moon: can you cover my night shift?

replies: Negative, Earthling. Broadcasting NO on all frequencies.
Request rejected at the speed of light.
My antennae have folded. That is a no.
Error 404: yes not found.
NO has been sent to twelve galaxies. They agree.
I traveled four billion kilometers to say this: no.
Shields up. Request bounced.
In my galaxy we have 300 words for no. I'm using all of them.
Warp drive engaged. Direction: away from your request.
Beep-boop translation: never, in this timeline.
We checked every parallel universe. Still no.
Mission control has lost interest. Over and out.
The stars aligned to spell N-O.
Your request entered a black hole. Nothing comes back.
Gravity says down. I say no.
Teleporting my answer to you now: NOOO.

المركبة: تحديث متوفر. إعادة تشغيل الآن؟

مستعمرة المريخ: اجتماع أكسجين إجباري ٦ الصبح.

رُفض الطلب بسرعة الضوء.

قطعت ٤ مليار كيلومتر عشان أقولها: لا.

ترجمة «بيب بوب»: مستحيل في هذا الخط الزمني.
فتشنا كل الأكوان الموازية. برضو لا.
مركز التحكم فقد الاهتمام. انتهى الإرسال.
النجوم اصطفت عشان تكتب: ل-ا.
طلبك دخل ثقب أسود. ما يرجع منه شي.
الجاذبية تقول تحت. وأنا أقول لا.
جاري نقل ردي إليك الآن: لااااا.
